'''November 2000 Virginia Beach tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Virginia Beach, VA on 5 November 2000. [[Curtis Brown]] won it. It is known from Brian Catalino's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1424">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-virginia-beach-va-11-5-2000d1424/ virginia-beach-va-11-5-2000], DeckTech (brian "darkjedi2000" catalino, 6 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-virginia-beach-va-11-5-2000d1424/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Virginia Beach, VA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Curtis Brown]]
